description: Defines classes and enums related to warning reporting categories, including plugin state analysis, message analysis, and flow control thresholds within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents the state of a plugin that has been active for too long, with analysis, serialization, deserialization, and string conversion functionalities.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Represents a message that has taken too long to process, supporting analysis from various message types, serialization, deserialization, and string conversion.

classes.name: FlowControlQueueSize
classes.description: Indicates critical flow control queue size thresholds with serialization and string conversion.

classes.name: FlowControlJobTime
classes.description: Indicates critical flow control job time thresholds with serialization and string conversion.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes input data to set internal state, overloaded for different message types.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes internal state into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes internal state from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts internal state to a human-readable string.
